project.name: Darsy
project.tagline: Full-Stack Educational Platform for Moroccan Students

plans.features: Full access, unlimited downloads, priority support

userRoles.description: Student consuming educational content, exploring subjects, taking quizzes, and interacting in community chats.
Verified educator providing chat support, leading rooms, and managing specific discussion areas.
Premium content creator responsible for uploading lessons, videos, and PDFs while tracking course metrics.
Platform manager overseeing users, content moderation, AI automations, systems integration, and marketing efforts.

frontend.name: Darsy Web (Student Interface)
frontend.technology: Next.js 16 (App Router), React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, next-intl
keyFeatures: Curriculum Explorer (Navigate by School > Level > Guidance > Subject > Lesson)
Comprehensive Lesson Player (PDFs, YouTube embeds, Exercises, Exams)
Educational News Hub with Q&A and Ratings
School Services Catalog (Informational directory for counseling, portals, forms)

adminPanel.name: Darsy Admin (Command Center)
keyFeatures: Global Analytics Dashboard (Users, Platform Growth, User Activity)
Hierarchical Curriculum Editor (Build and modify the entire school subject structure)
School Services Manager (Organize and publish custom student services cards)
AI Marketing Studio (Multi-Provider Context: Nebius, OpenRouter, Gemini)
Automated AI Tools: Poster Generation, Launch Ideas, Content Copywriting, Logo Generation
Teacher & Instructor Management (Verify qualifications, Moderate courses)
Database & Sync Tools (MongoDB synchronization, CSV Batch Uploading, Firebase Sync)

backendAPI.name: Darsy Backend
keyFeatures: Secure JWT Authentication (Access + Refresh Tokens, Google OAuth)
Real-Time Bidirectional Event Streaming (Socket.io) for chat by guidance level
File Storage via local volumes with optional Firebase sync
Comprehensive Endpoints covering Core Data, Progress, Services, Instructors, and Marketing AI Integrations

automations.name: Darsy Marketing Automations
automations.technology: n8n (Local Docker Integration), OpenAI, Telegram Webhooks
